_about: TRANSLATOR SHELF: S. S. Koteliansky (1880-1955), Russian into English with his Bloomsbury collaborators: Leonard and Virginia Woolf, D. H. Lawrence, John Middleton Murry. Chekhov, Gorky's Reminiscences, Bunin, Kuprin, Shestov, Countess Tolstoy. All published 1915-1923: US public domain. UK: Koteliansky d. 1955, so PD there only since 2026; Murry (d. 1957) co-translated The Bet, The River of Life and Anton Tchekhov and Other Essays, which are UK PD only from 2028. Added 2026-10-10 by lane C (round 17); Adam may veto. No uids minted.
